information.description:
The lowest rung of Arasaka security, guarding corporate sites worldwide in gear barely better than the street's. They're the fodder before the real threat arrives, so stop them calling it in.

Arasaka: The Japanese megacorp's security arm, from lobby guards to cyberninjas.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Its own Armor-Piercing rounds cost 20eb per 10 and fit only this gun.

Class: Very Heavy Pistol • POWER
Range table: Pistol
Damage: 4d6
Built-in: Power Rebuild

Item Compendium (2070) • Weapons
An Exotic, One-handed Medium Melee Weapon. Target is knocked unconscious if damage dealt would reduce them to under 1 HP. Doesn't cause Critical Injuries or ablate armor.

SP4. No penalty. Padded riding leathers.

Cost: 20eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Armor & Shields

Arasaka Guard: TUp (+1 SP) Kevlar

SP7. No penalty. Can be cut into anything from a business suit to a bikini.

Cost: 50eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Armor & Shields

All types except shells. Ablates armor by 2 instead of 1. AP is the basic grade for grenades and rockets (100eb each).

Cost: 100eb (Premium) /10 (price per 10)

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives

Grenades. No damage; anyone hit rolls DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs or suffers Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear for 1 minute (no Bonus Damage).

Cost: 100eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives

Required for all non-medical cyberware. Contains: Neural Link (5 Neuralware slots, none used by the rest), Holophone, Biomonitor, Virtu (virtual experiences; full immersion when deep diving), HUD (labels, transcripts, subtitles; shown in any cybereye, replacing the Chyron), two Shard Slots (chipware sockets) and a Personal Link (pull-out interface plug). Has a basic firewall (Chapter 10 of the Core Rules).

Install: Hospital • HL: 7 (2d6)

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware

A radio in your skull: talk to anyone on your frequency within 1 mile.

Install: Mall • HL: 2 (1d6/2)

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware

Throwing a grenade, or anything else you can lob. A Ranged Attack with Athletics (DEX) at up to 25m/yds on the DV Thrown Weapon table; anyone who can Dodge bullets can Dodge it.

Grenades: equip it and load a grenade, the way you load a gun; the throw uses the grenade up. The grenade decides the damage: 6d6 unless it says otherwise.
